scope: local official Nakama runtime against synthetic Business fixture only; no real GameFleet allocation or Unity gameplay
image_provenance: uncommitted M5r worktree; exact submitted-source CI is a separate gate

reports.scope: isolated Nakama plugin, search RPC, matchmaker hook and synthetic binding check; no real GameFleet allocation or Fixed gameplay
checks: built static local-only fixture image from scratch; no base image pull
temporary PostgreSQL ready on tmpfs; database port is not published
official Nakama 3.41.0 runtime applied migrations to the isolated nakama database
live Nakama process loaded agones.so, ran GameFleet scope preflight, and registered the GameFleet bridge
legacy Agones FleetManager registration log absent; invalid legacy DB URL was bypassed
two synthetic Nakama devices authenticated and each received current=null through gamefleet_current_v1
search begin RPC creates owned pending searches and exact request replay recovers the same ID
two websocket MatchmakerAdd requests passed owned-pending before status and the matched hook bound one exact pair
bound search status and cancel preserve one reserved room visible through Current

v2 routed pool metadata stayed out of player search RPCs; hostile query/string/numeric routing fields were replaced, and a two-interval A/B/A/B cohort matched only A-A and B-B in the simulated fixture
cross-participant status/cancel and a late MatchmakerAdd for a cancelled search are rejected
independent gfsvc mode uses v2 mapped search admission, v1 Match, and separate v1 History status/cancel; no ordinary caller routes
deny scope made Nakama exit nonzero before readiness, without backend fallback
history-read-only scope made Nakama exit nonzero before readiness, without backend fallback
limits: Synthetic local Business fixture only; no real GameFleet reservation, host, endpoint, ticket, or allocation was tested.
Temporary PostgreSQL database contains only this smoke's Nakama auth/state and is deleted at cleanup.
Loopback fixture and Nakama API are local-only; no production credentials or service were used.
